# Manual Blockscout verification (Robinhood Chain 4663)

All 19 contracts below are already verified on Sourcify (exact match): https://repo.sourcify.dev/4663/0x67bAEC5f4f7d7Bf608ce7468020cE7ADc8003788

Use these files only if the Blockscout page still shows "Verify & publish".

On the contract page click **Verify & publish**, then choose:

- Verification method: **Solidity (Standard JSON input)**
- Compiler: **v0.8.24+commit.e11b9ed9**
- Standard JSON input: the file named in the table, from this folder
- Contract name: the name in the table
- Constructor arguments: Blockscout detects them; if asked, paste the value from the table (empty means none)

The files carry the exact compiler settings used for deployment (optimizer 200 runs, viaIR, EVM cancun).
